=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:129-139 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _title_candidates unconditionally strips a `PR #<N> — ` prefix, which can classify a title as a stage and cause an active issue-start session to be archived.
  WHY: The stripped title can match STAGE_TITLE_PATTERN and enter later_stages, allowing it to supersede an issue-start session; reviewers disagree on whether this behavior is intentional, and severity ranges from NIT to MAJOR.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:106 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _page_shape calls .get() on payload without confirming it is a dictionary.
  WHY: If the input is a list, payload.get("ccr") raises AttributeError and the janitor exits 2, stopping the sweep.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:51 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: subprocess.run(["gh", "api", path]...) inherits the environment.
  WHY: Environment secrets could leak or environment variables such as GIT_* or PATH could interfere with subprocess execution.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:214 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: load_page surfaces only a generic “cannot read --sessions” error after JSON parse failures, without logging the specific parse error or partial data.
  WHY: The pickup cannot distinguish a malformed harness wrapper or truncated page from a real JSON error, delaying diagnosis of session-list problems.
- changelog.d/4887-archive-finished-sessions.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The sentence “The Claude issue pickup's hourly wake archives the fixer, issue-start, and report sessions nothing else archived” is missing a relative pronoun or auxiliary verb.
  WHY: The sentence reads incorrectly.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:129-139 (_title_candidates) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The pr_prefix match at line 136 and the candidate append at lines 137-138 execute unconditionally, outside the if issue_prefix: guard.
  WHY: Same as above — the test at line 109 proves the spurious stage classification. The fix is to indent lines 136-138 into the if issue_prefix: block and add an else pass to keep the return symmetry.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:51 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: subprocess.run(["gh", "api", path]...) inherits the environment.
  WHY: Could leak environment secrets or interfere with subprocess execution if dangerous environment variables (e.g., GIT_*, PATH) are present in the runner environment.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:106 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: _page_shape calls .get() on payload without confirming it is a dictionary.
  WHY: If the input is a list (e.g., [1, 2]), payload.get("ccr") raises AttributeError, causing load_page to fail and the janitor to exit 2, stopping the sweep.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:136 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The strip pr_prefix = PR_PREFIX_PATTERN.match(rest) is applied to rest (which may be the original title if issue_prefix did not match) without checking if an issue prefix should have been there.
  WHY: A spurious match might occur if a non-fixer title happens to match FIXER_TITLE_PATTERN after an accidental strip, potentially leading to incorrect archival of an active session.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  WHY: Such a stage is added to later_stages:281 (does not match NON_SUPERSEDING_STAGE_PATTERN), superseding an earlier issue-start for the same issue. Test in tests/test_claude_session_janitor.py:268 (parametrized with stage_hours=12 > issue-start 10h) asserts no supersede, but code does—test/code mismatch on intent.

  WHY: Pickup sees opaque error on bad page; cannot distinguish harness wrapper truncation from real JSON error, delaying diagnosis of session-list problems.
